quote.text: My hopes, from my earliest years, have been hopes of celebrity as a writer- not of wealth, or of influence, or of accomplishing any of the thousand aims which furnish the great bulk of mankind with motives. For who does not know'How vain that second life in others' breath,The estate which wits inherit after death!'And what can be more fraught with the ludicrous than an union of this shadowy ambition with mediocre parts and attainments!
